Independent band or self-funded brand?

Ask for our independent rate. We offer a reduced studio fee for self-funded projects by independent bands and owner-run brands. Your written quote shows the standard fee, your discount and the final total. Third-party costs are separate.

04 / PEOPLE & PROCESSTHE RED STUDIO / TRONDHEIM

The people
you’ll work with.

We’re Shubham and Rajiv. A small studio born in Trondheim, with a direct line between you and the people making the work.

Bring the question, the early draft or the complicated diagram. We’ll work with you to make it clear, without losing what makes it accurate.

Meet the studio ↗

Shubham Jain

FOUNDER

Talk to Shubham about your goals, timing and budget. He helps turn the first conversation into a clear plan for the project.

Rajiv Priyadarshi

CHIEF DESIGN OFFICER

Talk to Rajiv about the design. He shapes the visual direction and works through the details with you, from early ideas to final files.

NO GUESSWORK / HERE’S HOW WE WORK

Your research
You check the facts and scientific meaning. We make the explanation clearer. Sources, tools and any proposed AI use are discussed openly.
Your data
We can start with sample data. Before you share anything sensitive, we agree who needs access and how long files are kept. How we handle data ↗
Your budget
A written scope, price and timeline before we begin. Two feedback rounds in each package. Changes are priced and approved before we do them. See the numbers ↗
